name: silu
summary: y[i] = x[i] * sigmoid(x[i]) = x[i] / (1 + exp(-x[i])) over n f32 elements

y.why: y = x / (1 + E), E = exp(-x) computed in f32 (negation exact). exp budget: OpenCL exp <= 3 ulp (OpenCL C 3.0 s7.4), CUDA expf <= 2 ulp; 1 ulp <= 2u relative, so 3 ulp <= 6u (WolframLanguageEvaluator: 3*2^-23/2^-24 -> 6). Since E/(1+E) < 1, the relative error of 1+E is at most that of E, <= 6u <= gamma(6); the add and the divide add one rounding each, so by Higham Lemma 3.3 y = x/(1+e^-x) * (1+theta_8), |theta_8| <= gamma(8) (WolframLanguageEvaluator: 8u/(1-8u), u=2^-24 -> 4.768e-7). Omega computes exp in binary64 and rounds once (<= u + binary64 error). Inputs in [-16,16] keep E and y normal in f32.
